entries.en: innumerable; countless, myriad (ten thousand myriads)

entries.zh: 万端；头绪繁多，各式各样（不可胜数）
entries.en: myriad, manifold; of countless kinds and aspects
all things, all creation; everything
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 声调标记污损难辨（T99）；汉字「巷」与音写 xia（dzia）及西语 inquietar「烦扰」义难以互证。

entries.en: to disturb, to stir up; to unsettle
entries.notes: 西语词头截断为 Ynquietar-；汉字「掩」与音写例句（guiau: gian xiau do so abaxo utalhuyad，夹有西语 abajo）难以完整互证，取 inquietar 17 世纪义。

entries.en: to disturb, to stir up
entries.notes: 西语词头截断为 Ynquietar-；汉字「儀」与其音写 guiau 不合，短语 I cho lang: cho mo 难解，取 inquietar 义。

entries.en: clamorous, noisy; restless and disquieted in spirit
confused, disordered; a disquieted, troubled heart
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语栏空白，汉字存疑（珆/殆），音写 fai 无法定夺词义。

entries.en: clamoring, shouting; restless, without peace
restless, troubled; entangled, complicated (anudado)
entries.notes: 汉字「掩散」与音写 guiau çoa 难以互证，取西语 inquieto、anuido（疑为 anudado，纷缠不安）义。

entries.en: to soak, steep; to pour into (fig. worry seeping into the heart)
entries.notes: 汉字「浸注」与音写 chim chu 相合，但与词头 ynquiess（疑为 inquietesse 之截式）的关联依赖推断。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字存疑（巷兒家/巷完家）且声调污损难辨（T99），音写 xia vangüe 无法可靠解读。

entries.zh: 炒心；心绪被搅动，烦躁不安
entries.en: to stir up the heart; mentally agitated, turbulent

entries.zh: 炒腸肚；为俗务心肠烦乱（喻心绪如炒翻）
entries.en: troubled heart over worldly affairs; lit. 'stir-fried guts', i.e. churned innards

entries.zh: 东立西立；摇摆不定，无所定凭
entries.en: wavering, standing now east then west; unsettled, no firm trust in any quarter

entries.zh: 学霸；学堂恶霸、搅扰学堂之人
entries.en: school bully, tyrant at school; troublemaker
entries.notes: 17 世纪义为学堂中称霸搅扰者，非现代「成绩优异」义。

entries.zh: 惊惶不安；为俗务心慌意乱
entries.en: flustered, alarmed; disquieted over worldly affairs
entries.notes: 汉字栏存疑（悽惶/愴惶），音写 chong hong 近「仓皇」一类惊惶义，取西语「为俗务烦乱」为义。

entries.zh: 心被搅动；心绪紊乱不安
entries.en: heart stirred into disquiet; troubled, disordered heart
entries.notes: 西语 con desorden de dad 残损难解；汉字「慈心動」（心被牵动）与西语「心绪紊乱」仅部分相合。

entries.zh: 造谣生事、以恶行扰人；臭名昭著之行
entries.en: to stir up trouble by raising slander, false reports; infamous conduct
